purpose: Declares the material each F11 assessment slot carries for the pre-RC candidate, by role, from the bound scope (classification.json partitions), the rule catalog and the role policy. It selects bytes for J; it supplies no authority and no judgment.
promptBoundSource: T-287 Phase D, D5 activation: a prompt above 1,048,576 bytes is a stop

roleSources.rule: QUALIFICATION_ROLE_POLICY.authoritySourceRefs (REQ-P-SELF-CONFORMANCE.md, REQ-P-QUAL.md), as catalog sources with their bytes, in every slot (validator/qualification.ts:476-481)

roles.coverage: ruleRef = one rule group, surfaceRef = the rule catalog ref, evidenceRole = catalog_fidelity (validator/qualification.ts:409-412)
roles.material: the role sources, the rule group's source bytes and every published rule row of that source (qualificationSelectedSubject, :424-441)

roles.coverage: ruleRef = the inventory ref, surfaceRef = one surface group, evidenceRole = inventory_coverage or inventory_classification (:408)
roles.material: the role sources, every member of the surface group and the group's source refs (classification.json) (:398-405, :413-420)

roles.coverage: ruleRef = one rule group, surfaceRef = one surface group of that rule group's domain, evidenceRole = semantic_assessment (:400-407)
roles.material: the role sources, the rule group's source bytes and every member of the surface group (:413-420)
the role sources, tenant-manifest.json and the subject members the claims cite
the role sources, contracts/qualification/coverage.json and the subject members the claims cite

fit: A slot's material is the sum of its role sources, its rule or catalog sources and its surface group members, as base64 bodies inside the rendered prompt. A surface group or a single member whose bytes exceed the bound cannot be carried by one slot; the qualification driver's prepare mode measures every group and member against the bound and projects the slot count and cost before any provider dispatch.
provenance: The pre-RC subject was constructed outside ABG across many sessions and commits. F11 J over tenant and inventory attribution requires an external_construction provenance (activation, preimage, delta and closure records per chain; qualification_contracts.ts:132-140). No resource of this directory carries it; it is named a gap, not constructed.
